capture_source_note: Per-frame coordinates.jsonl and raw/visibility.jsonl are existing immutable capture artifacts read from the original Regime A S3 prefixes. They are the only way to reconstruct a per-row causal last-evidence world position. Each is hash-verified against durable_receipt.json, which is itself hash-verified against the P0-bound analysis_input_binding.json. No activations were read.
